children: HCM IV Acquisition had net income of $2.2M in the quarter, compared with a net loss in the prior-year period, reflecting $2.4M of interest income on Trust Account investments, partly offset by $256,201 in general and administrative costs. The company has not selected a business combination target.
: Held $293.6M in cash and marketable securities as of September 30, 2026, including approximately $6.1M of interest income.
: The company has not selected a target and has not initiated substantive discussions with any target.
: Cash outside the Trust Account was $612,474, and working capital deficit was $256,767 as of September 30, 2026.
: Management said it lacks resources to sustain operations for a reasonable period and plans to pursue a business combination and may seek Sponsor working capital loans.
